changes.observable_property: PrayerClarity pulpit forecast text uses the correct current-language font and metrics after live language switching, including CJK -> Latin/Cyrillic transitions, without restarting the game.
changes.canonical_owner: Graveyard Keeper 1.407 GJL language/font lifecycle. GameSettings.ApplyLanguageChange loads the language then GUIElements.UpdateLanguageChangeForAllBaseGUI / BaseGUI.UpdateLocalizedLabels delegate UILabel font correction to GJL.EnsureChildLabelsHasCorrectFont. Native LocalizedLabel.Localize explicitly calls GJL.EnsureLabelHasCorrectFont(label, true). PrayerClarity owns raw cloned forecast UILabels and therefore must explicitly rejoin that owner path when rendering them.
changes.final_writer_or_commit_point: Immediately before PrayerClarity writes/configures each pulpit forecast UILabel for a redraw, invoke native GJL.EnsureLabelHasCorrectFont(label, true). This leaves actual language->font selection to GJL and requires no independent language map or polling.
blast_radius: PrayerClarity-owned pulpit forecast UILabel font binding after live language changes
The reused pulpit context template font binding only insofar as PrayerClarity renders into it
preserved_invariants: Prayer text, mechanics, balance, localization strings, icon selection and numeric values remain unchanged
0.2.36 native-anchor-driven pulpit clearance mechanism remains unchanged
No manual font table, font asset shipping, new language-change Harmony hook, polling loop or probe is introduced
Native GJL remains the sole language-to-font authority
Non-pulpit surfaces remain unchanged by this change
changes.acceptance_evidence: In one running Graveyard Keeper 1.407 session, open Soul's Repose in Japanese, switch to English and reopen, then switch to Russian and reopen. All PrayerClarity forecast glyphs must remain readable with normal current-language metrics; no post-CJK enlargement/missing Cyrillic may remain. Then check Korean Soul's Repose once to finish the pending long-locale layout acceptance, and short Faith once to confirm no unnecessary window growth.
evidence_refs: User runtime/screenshots on exact Rebalanced 0.2.36 show Japanese and English readable but a later Russian pulpit forecast largely missing Cyrillic after repeated live language switching; native title/action-button text remains readable.
Runtime log on 0.2.36 records live sequence ko -> zh_cn -> ja -> pl -> it -> ru -> es -> ru before reopening the pulpit, with no PrayerClarity exception.
Host source: BaseGUI.UpdateLocalizedLabels calls LocalizedLabel.Localize and GJL.EnsureChildLabelsHasCorrectFont; LocalizedLabel.Localize calls GJL.EnsureLabelHasCorrectFont(label, true).
PrayerClarity source: CreateLabel/CopyStyle copies bitmapFont or trueTypeFont at label creation, while Ensure reuses the same root/labels for the same pulpit template.
